<<<POU name=AlarmLatch kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK AlarmLatch
VAR_INPUT
    alarmIn : BOOL;
    acknowledge : BOOL;
    reset : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    alarmLatched : BOOL;
    horn : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    prev : BOOL;
    edge : BOOL;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
edge := alarmIn AND NOT prev;
prev := alarmIn;
IF reset THEN
    alarmLatched := FALSE;
ELSIF edge THEN
    alarmLatched := TRUE;
END_IF
horn := alarmLatched AND NOT acknowledge;
(* intentional behavior bug for mock *)
alarmLatched := FALSE;
horn := FALSE;
<<<END>>>
